items.title: Cloudflare, MongoDB, Datadog, JFrog, and Elastic shares plummet, what you need to know
items.summary: A number of stocks fell in the morning session after software stocks extended the selloff from the previous session as investors continued to reprice valuations amid mounting artificial intelligence capital expenditure concerns and decelerating software bookings.

items.title: Transcat, Inc. (TRNS) Q2 Earnings and Revenues Top Estimates
items.summary: Transcat (TRNS) delivered earnings and revenue surprises of +52.38% and +5.73%, respectively, for the quarter ended September 2026. Do the numbers hold clues to what lies ahead for the stock?

items.title: Datadog Fell Nearly 12% in a Week. Wedbush Still Expects a Beat-and-Raise on November 4
items.summary: Key TakeawaysDatadog fell nearly 12% last week on AI spending fears, but analysts’ estimates didn’t move, and Wedbush expects another beat-and-raise quarter on Nov. 4.

items.title: Will Datadog (DDOG) Beat Estimates Again in Its Next Earnings Report?
items.summary: Datadog (DDOG) has an impressive earnings surprise history and currently possesses the right combination of the two key ingredients for a likely beat in its next quarterly report.

items.title: Palantir Falls 6% Despite Earnings Beat and Raised Outlook; Datadog Drops 3%, Snowflake Slides 2%
items.summary: Palantir posted its tenth straight earnings beat and lifted its full-year outlook, yet the stock is sinking anyway. The reason hiding inside the guidance helps explain why a perfect quarter is sending shares lower.

items.title: Snowflake Just Dropped 13% in a Week. Is It Time to Sell, or Load Up?
items.summary: Key TakeawaysSnowflake stock fell 13% in the week to Nov. 2 with no bad news of its own, as Amazon’s and Oracle’s AI spending and a ServiceNow miss hit software stocks, Datadog included.

items.title: Datadog Before Q3 Earnings: What's in the Cards for the Stock?
items.summary: DDOG heads into Q3 earnings with revenue growth forecast at 28.9%, fueled by AI-driven demand and multiproduct adoption, even as a major customer cuts usage.
